part.text:
The image contains two colours, split vertically down the middle:

- **Blue** — the left half (a deep azure/royal blue, roughly #0066CC)
- **Yellow** — the right half (a bright golden yellow, roughly #FFCC00)

These are the colours of the flag of Ukraine, arranged here as a vertical bicolor (left–right) rather than the usual horizontal (top–bottom) arrangement.
